{{nihongo|'''Mimatsuhiko Shrine'''|御間都比古神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Mimatsuhiko Shrine''' (みまつひこじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in {{ill|Sanagōchi, Tokushima|Q1206355|qid=Q1206355}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}.

=== History ===
The founding year is unknown. The enshrined Mimatsuhiko Iroto no Mikoto is a pioneering deity of Sanagōchi. It is said that in the era of {{ill|Emperor Seimu|Q316672|qid=Q316672}}, the ninth-generation descendant {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Karasokeni}} became {{ill|Naga no Kuni no Miyatsuko|Q21653903|qid=Q21653903}} and originally enshrined this deity at the middle slope of Nagamine (present-day Shimo-Nakamine). In the era of {{ill|Emperor Daigo|Q329753|qid=Q329753}}, it was listed as a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=kokuhei shōsha}}.
